note.question: How would the growing prevalence of real-time delay information affect a service system?
note.overview: How would the growing prevalence of real-time delay information affect a service system? The model considers a single-server queueing system where customers arrive according to a Poisson process and the service time follows an exponential distribution. There are two streams of customers, one informed about real-time delay and the other uninformed.
